labels.body_text_too_small: Substantive body text cannot be read continuously because of font size, contrast, or line spacing.
labels.figure_detail_unreadable: Labels, nodes, numbers, legends, or other details required to understand a figure or table cannot be read in the full-poster view.
labels.text_overload: Text remains technically readable, but its total amount, long passages, or bullet count prevents rapid scanning of the main message.
labels.space_imbalance: A large uninformative blank area coexists with crowding elsewhere, or visual weight is clearly and unintentionally concentrated on one side.
labels.alignment_error: Grid, column width, margin, panel boundary, or baseline has a visible non-design misalignment.
labels.weak_hierarchy: The entry point, reading order, or key conclusion is unclear, or secondary elements incorrectly dominate attention.
labels.overlap_or_clipping: Meaningful text or imagery is occluded, crosses a boundary, is visibly truncated, or loses content; an ellipsis counts only when the visible sentence is semantically incomplete.
labels.asset_missing_or_broken: An empty placeholder, loading failure, corrupted fragment, or erroneous stretching or rotation is visible.
labels.other: A moderate or severe visible defect that cannot be mapped to another label.

none_definition: No visible defect reaches moderate or severe severity. Minor issues may still be recorded.
